data.narrative:
Kelluu is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised €20M+. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 10 private companies and 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) operating in the same sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression approach uses the €20M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, implying a $40M valuation. The peer-median method examines four same-stage Defense & Security companies: Stark Defence ($4.0B), Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M). The median across this sample is $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B, reflecting substantial dispersion within the peer set.

Triangulating these two methods produces a range of $34M to $805M, with a median of $370M. The wide spread reflects the heterogeneity of Series A valuations in the Defense & Security sector, where outcomes range from moderate to unicorn-scale. Stage-progression suggests the low end of the range, while peer-median pulls toward the upper half. Key uncertainties include Kelluu's relative position on product maturity, customer traction, and defensibility versus the peer sample, all of which could materially shift positioning within this range.
